GI and pelvic complaints are accompanied by normal vitals, normal CBC, normal CRP/ESR, negative fecal occult blood, and no peritoneal signs or fever. The patient has repeated similar presentations over the past year and is seeking care frequently. There is no evidence of infection, inflammation, or objective organ pathology on available testing, and no clear external incentive for symptom reporting. This pattern—multiple, persistent somatic symptoms across organ systems, causing distress and repeated healthcare utilization despite normal investigations—most closely fits somatic symptom disorder rather than an acute organic disease, conversion disorder, or factitious/malingering causes.

DIAGNOSIS: Somatic symptom disorder (predominant pain)
